tagline: Shape the argument, write in sequence, keep what sounds right

highlights.title: Approve the Argument First
highlights.description: WordTaste puts the core claims in front of you before it writes. Confirm the shape and mark only the few places that deserve the strongest landing.

highlights.title: Choose by Feel, Not Metadata
highlights.description: Hard passages earn genuinely different alternatives with neutral labels. No model names, word counts, or internal controls bias the decision.

highlights.title: Point at the One Line
highlights.description: Select the sentence that still feels false and ask for a few ways through. Every real choice and hand edit becomes useful material for the next piece.
